summary:
DumbBudget is a single-page budget tracker behind a 4-digit PIN (2468). Signing in is the replay prelude. I saved 2 views:
1) dashboard: the main page showing the balance, income and expense totals, the Add Transaction button, the date range picker, the November 2026 transaction list with recurring markers and notes, the sort controls, and the CSV/PDF export buttons.
2) edit-transaction: the add/edit modal (Income/Expense toggle, amount, description, notes, date, Update button, recurring checkbox). It opens on an existing freelance income entry over the list filtered to income, which also shows the filtered state of the list.
I tried saving the empty Add Transaction modal (Expense type with the category field and recurrence interval showing) as its own view. The harness rejected it as a near-duplicate of the dashboard, because the long list underneath outweighs the modal. The app has no other screens apart from the login page and the PDF/CSV export files, which aren't screens.
